allison-1: Burgundy satin, five ways. Garden roses, ranunculus and dahlias with plum velvet ribbon, the vineyard turning gold behind them.
brittney-1: Bunny tails and bleached ruscus, wired to hold for twelve hours. A boutonniere is four inches of design — no reason it should be an afterthought.
danielle-1: The last hook, fastened by her mother. Garden light through the window does the rest.
drew-kaila-1: A quiet minute between the fruit trees. Black and white keeps everything that mattered.
felicia-1: Getting-ready light, and a bride who brought her own colour.
gabby-matthew-1: Pearl-beaded straps and layers of tulle, hung in window light. The quiet hour before everything.
hannah-1: Two bouquets built as a pair — blush, ivory, and silver eucalyptus, ribbon left long. The house on the hill did the rest.
inna-1: A greenery garland edges the sweetheart table, burgundy peonies and ivory blooms set against an open summer field.
jeanna-1: Macrame and exposed brick, softened at one corner with fern, eucalyptus and cream roses. The fringe does the moving.
jess-rich-1: Waxflower and spray roses braided into a crown, resting beside blush block heels on the windowsill. Soft green light through the glass.
jessica-bailey-1: Blue, navy, black — three generations of suits at the woodland's edge, laughing easily.
kathrine-rizzi-1: Peonies, anemones, and a thread of pale blue through every bouquet. The dresses set the palette; the flowers agreed with it.
krystin-1: The whole party in sage at the water's edge, white roses and silver dollar eucalyptus in every hand. Last light off the lake.
madeline-1: Ivory roses and anemones, interrupted on purpose — blue sea holly gives a soft bouquet its spine.
mikeera-1: Sixteen people, one palette. Navy, sea glass, and white bouquets tied in blue ribbon — big parties read best when the flowers keep it simple.
nadine-1: Peach dahlias and toffee garden roses, gathered loose for a vineyard evening. Warm palettes earn their keep at golden hour.
nenna-1: A crescent of burgundy dahlias and white ranunculus on a brass hoop. Asymmetry does the work symmetry can't.
nicole-1: White roses on white pedestals, the skyline gone soft behind them. A waterfront terrace needs little else.
rose-will-1: A quiet minute in the getting-ready room. Hands folded, head down, the day about to begin.
sabrina-1: Getting-ready light on a lace bodice, and a bouquet of white roses, lisianthus, and eucalyptus keeping the palette quiet.
samantha-1: A cedar arch under the fan window, draped in white with two loose clusters of roses and greenery. The room fills quietly with light.
shannon-1: Blush garden roses, ivory ranunculus and a few burgundy notes against a navy lapel. Autumn vine turns the backdrop crimson.
susan-1: Charcoal suit, blush tie, an ivory bloom with berries at the lapel. The quietest details still read.
teena-1: Just married, and sun through the trees. A loose gathering of white blooms and trailing greenery in hand for the walk back.
allison-2: A vineyard row in full October colour. Her bouquet trails plum ribbon past hills that did the decorating themselves.
danielle-2: A kiss at the temple. Burgundy dahlias, blush and pink roses and eucalyptus in hand, a woodland floral pillar behind them.

felicia-2: The last buttons before the aisle. Low light, and pink hair pinned into soft waves.
gabby-matthew-2: A closer study of the beading: pearls in every size, set edge to edge along one strap of tulle.

inna-2: One burgundy dahlia at the centre, blush roses and glossy greenery around it. Blush napkins folded into the glasses under the tent.

jess-rich-2: Blush garden roses and baby's breath on ruffled buttercream. The letterboard keeps the speech short.

kathrine-rizzi-2: Delphinium, chamomile, and white ranunculus against blush and rose gowns. The laughing was not staged.
madeline-2: White spray rose, wax flower and blue sea holly on a navy shawl lapel, tied off with a torn dusty-blue ribbon.
mikeera-2: A loose gathering of white anemone, ranunculus and blue sea holly in grey eucalyptus. Thistle gives the softness an edge.
nadine-2: Loose stems by the card box — cream garden rose, white dahlia, lisianthus, ruscus trailing across white linen.
nenna-2: White anemones and burgundy dahlias against a star-scattered cape. Woodland light finds the bouquet first.
nicole-2: A ceremony deck on the water, skyline across the harbour. White blooms line the aisle and let the view speak.
rose-will-2: Grey wool and blush ties between the vine rows. One groomsman grins through the canopy.
sabrina-2: White roses, lisianthus and ranunculus over the day's small things — the invitation, the shoes, the rings. Everything ready at once.
samantha-2: Bare spring trees and a bouquet that refuses to match them: anemones, ranunculus, tulips, a trail of blue ribbon.
shannon-2: String lights, a white column and a red maple in full turn. A blush and burgundy bouquet against her fur wrap.
susan-2: Bouquets in a row, waiting for their people. Blush and ivory roses, lisianthus, and astilbe under silver eucalyptus.
teena-2: Pinning the boutonniere — a white calla and lisianthus with variegated pittosporum against a black lapel.

danielle-3: White blooms in her hair, coral garden rose and burgundy dahlia in hand, eucalyptus cooling the palette.
felicia-3: Shot through the veil. Pink hair, pearl drop earrings, and a smile that needed no direction.
gabby-matthew-3: Two hands, falling snow, layers of tulle. Winter did the rest.
hannah-3: A bride at the tall window, dark wood trim framing her. Quicksand and mauve roses with silver dollar eucalyptus, tied in ribbon.

jeanna-3: Vows read under macrame and greenery, old brick warming the whole room.

nenna-3: Black-eyed anemones and plum dahlias in a drift of cream roses and fern. Her mother's hand close by, in burgundy.

rose-will-3: Rows of vines and a soft grey sky. One of them is holding the pose; the other is committing to the bit.
sabrina-3: Shuttered light and a bow tie. A single rose boutonniere, tied off with ribbon.
samantha-3: Lavender garden rose front and centre, blush rose beside it, dark astrantia rising behind. White peony and wax flower soften the base.
shannon-3: Hand in hand under the pavilion's string lights, gold lettering overhead. A pause between the ceremony and the party.
susan-3: Mauve and blush roses, white stock and astilbe, silver dollar eucalyptus. Window light on a waiting bouquet.

felicia-4: Lip liner, steady hands, and pink hair braided into an updo. The dress waits in the light behind.

inna-4: Black dahlia, burgundy peony, cream garden rose — silver dollar eucalyptus keeps a dark palette breathing.
jeanna-4: Vows in the loft: brick, macrame, and a corner of blooms overhead. Olive silk lined up behind them.
jess-rich-4: A flower crown of spray roses and baby's breath, an armful of ivory garden roses, and a brick wall softened by ivy.

nicole-4: A ceremony deck over the water, city skyline behind. White roses and delphinium spill from the aisle in low clusters.

susan-4: Blush roses, cream ranunculus, snapdragon and pink astilbe, tied with pale ribbon against white satin.

danielle-5: A spin for his mother under the string lights. The whole courtyard watched.
hannah-5: Quicksand roses in every stage of open, mauve astrantia between, silver dollar eucalyptus at the edges. Stems left long.

nadine-5: One corner of the arch: white drape, loose greenery, and garden roses from blush to bronze. The vineyard blurs behind.

shannon-5: Blush garden roses and white ranunculus with rust dahlias, eucalyptus falling loose across white lace.
susan-5: Low rings of blush and ivory roses in glossy greenery, gold chiavari all around. A ballroom in afternoon light.
allison-6: Yellow ranunculus, red roses, and burgundy dahlias against tulle, with a run of plum velvet ribbon. The sparkle came on the shoes.
hannah-6: Her vows, twice over — velvet and linen books ringed with blush garden roses, white stock and wax flower.

shannon-6: The morning flat lay — blush and crimson blooms, lace shoes tied in ribbon, two rings in a dish marked S + C.
allison-7: Pillar candles the length of the table, a garland of terracotta roses and deep reds threading between.
hannah-7: The paper tells it first: two vow books, velvet ring boxes, and an invitation edged in blush roses and waxflower.
jeanna-7: Knots, fringe, and one long tassel. Macrame panels layered against old brick, greenery just entering the frame.
jess-rich-7: A weathered lantern on a wine barrel, wreathed in white hydrangea, blush garden roses and lemon leaf. Brick and shutters behind.
kathrine-rizzi-7: A white ranunculus and sprigs of feverfew tied with raw silk. Small enough to whisper against the paisley bow tie.
nadine-7: Peach ranunculus, blush dahlias and a coral garden rose, coral silk ribbon dropping past her hands.
nicole-7: A kiss at the head table, greenery climbing the white brick behind them. Blush roses and candlelight soft in the foreground.
shannon-7: Rust chrysanthemums, quicksand roses, and blush ranunculus under seeded eucalyptus. Autumn, up close.

jess-rich-8: A bride and her mother, ivory roses and ranunculus between them. Old brick and window light.

nicole-8: Under the willow, matching bouquets of white roses. Her maid of honour wore black, and it works.

kathrine-rizzi-9: Laughter under the locust tree. Pink peony, blush roses and a stem of blue delphinium against navy.
nicole-9: Bouquets up under the willow. Black dresses, white blooms, and shade that flatters everyone.

kathrine-rizzi-11: Candlelight down the garland — cream roses tucked into ruscus and fern, blue delphinium in bud vases beyond.

nicole-12: Three white roses, two bud vases, one pillar candle. A quiet corner of the reception doing a lot with a little.

kathrine-rizzi-15: One long table under string lights, bud vases of garden flowers down the middle, greenery pillars at the far end. Whitewashed brick keeps it bright.
